description: This is a Zephyr RTOS sample source file implementing virtual network interfaces, including initialization, attachment, and configuration of virtual and tunnel interfaces, with logging and setup routines.

methods.name: virtual_test_iface_init
methods.description: Initializes a virtual network interface, sets its name and flags.

methods.name: virtual_test_get_capabilities
methods.description: Returns capabilities of the virtual interface (none in this case).

methods.name: virtual_test_interface_send
methods.description: Sends data through the virtual interface.

methods.name: virtual_test_interface_recv
methods.description: Handles received data on the virtual interface.

methods.name: virtual_test_interface_attach
methods.description: Attaches a virtual interface to another network interface.

methods.name: iface_cb
methods.description: Callback to process network interfaces and assign to context.

methods.name: setup_iface
methods.description: Configures IPv6 and IPv4 addresses, peer addresses, and MTU for a network interface.

methods.name: main
methods.description: Main function initializing network interfaces, attaching virtual interfaces, and setting IP addresses.
